current_role: Major hospital serving northern Central Coast
veca_interpretation: Recent redevelopment strongly reinforces Wyong as a durable northern Central Coast health node.

asset_name: Gosford Hospital + University of Newcastle Gosford health/education precinct
current_role: Regional tertiary health and clinical education cluster
veca_interpretation: Hospital, clinical school and university presence make Gosford a deliberately reinforced knowledge/health centre rather than a generic town centre.
New university investment on NSW Government land adds durable CBD knowledge gravity and shows government land can be used to manufacture a regional anchor.
Multi-campus upgrades align skills infrastructure with regional growth sectors and reinforce the existing three-node Central Coast pattern.
UNE is one of Armidale's defining institutions and a major reason the regional plan describes Armidale as the higher-education heart of New England.
A new central-city university campus increases Tamworth's service and knowledge gravity and demonstrates deliberate redistribution of tertiary education within the region.
Reinforces Moree as a service centre in parallel with Special Activation Precinct investment.
Incremental strengthening of the existing service hierarchy rather than spatially flexible capital.

asset_name: Northside Hospital / North Canberra Hospital campus
veca_interpretation: Largest ACT health-infrastructure investment and a major future service anchor; site choice is now effectively fixed on the existing North Canberra campus.

current_role: Major tertiary health campus and southern service anchor
veca_interpretation: The Southern Gateway framework treats Canberra Hospital and Woden as a long-term integrated precinct to 2050 and beyond.
Major redevelopment completed in 2021; this is now sunk regional service gravity rather than movable future capital.

asset_name: Albury Wodonga Regional Hospital - Albury campus
veca_interpretation: Current project consolidates complex care at Albury; capital is increasingly locked despite continuing local-government advocacy for a new single-site hospital.
Government plans preserve the site while shifting complex care toward Albury, making this a strong example of service-role optionality without full site relocation.
Largest TAFE campus in the Riverina; supports trades, nursing, community services and other workforce functions.
Purpose-built trade and health-training facilities add to Albury-Wodonga's labour-market depth.
Repeated expansion reinforces Traralgon/Latrobe as the dominant Gippsland health-service node.
University workforce strategy aims to materially expand locally trained graduates to 2050, strengthening regional human-capital capacity.

asset_name: Ipswich Hospital + UniSQ Ipswich knowledge and technology precinct
current_role: Western SEQ health and education anchor
veca_interpretation: ShapingSEQ explicitly identifies this precinct as critical to growth in the Western sub-region; this is a direct example of service infrastructure shaping settlement geography.

asset_name: New Toowoomba Hospital / Baillie Henderson health and knowledge campus
current_role: Future major Darling Downs hospital campus
veca_interpretation: Relocation of major health services to a new integrated campus shows that hospital renewal can be used to create a new service geography when acted on early enough.
